title: Psychology Facts
hook: Your brain cannot let go of unfinished things.
facts: It is called the Zeigarnik effect, named after a Russian psychologist.
Unfinished tasks tend to stay in your mind more than the ones you completed.
That is why a half watched series or a pending message keeps nagging you.
The trick? Write down your plan for finishing it, and the nagging often fades.
outro: Follow for a new mind blowing fact every day.
